verdict.rationale: Mistral documents an open-weights posture (Apache-2.0 licensed models like Mistral 7B, downloadable weights, self-host anywhere) which supports the 'tunable open weights' path, and model cards/catalog endpoints let engineers discover and pull specific weight releases. However, there is no evidence in the pack of a documented hosted fine-tuning API (endpoint, dataset upload, or fine-tuning job docs), and commercial fine-tuning/deployment of open weights is gated behind a separate license negotiation rather than a fully self-serve flow. Missing for 10: explicit fine-tuning API/job documentation, and clarity on self-serve commercial fine-tuning terms.
